records.issue_text: The find-then-create/update pattern for locating a credential by userId+appId in app-credential.ts is not atomic, allowing concurrent webhook calls to race and create duplicate credential rows
records.rationale: In `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the handler does `prisma.credential.findFirst({ where: { userId, appId } })` and then conditionally `update` or `create`. records.issue_text: The app-credential.ts webhook handler does not check req.method, so non-POST requests are processed instead of returning 405
records.rationale: In the newly added `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts` handler, there is no `req.method` check (e.g., restricting to POST). The function immediately validates headers and then calls `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)`, so non-POST requests (GET/PUT/etc.) will not return 405 and may error or be handled unintentionally.

records.issue_text: zoho-bigin api/add.ts hardcodes redirectUri to the literal string "zoho-bigin" instead of deriving it from appConfig.slug, creating a maintenance hazard if the slug ever diverges from the literal
records.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/api/add.ts`, the diff changes `redirectUri` from `WEBAPP_URL + `/api/integrations/${appConfig.slug}/callback`` to the hardcoded `WEBAPP_URL + `/api/integrations/zoho-bigin/callback``. This matches the finding: it introduces a concrete maintenance risk if `appConfig.slug` ever changes or diverges from the literal.
